rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings. Use Unbounded for a futuristic spatial UI feel.
Limit H1 to text-6xl ceiling. Do not use text-7xl or above.
Headlines > 32px MUST use tracking-tight.
Variable weights: Mix font-light and font-black for tension and contrast.
Use tinted greys, never pure #000000 or #808080. The background is a Deepest Void Black.
Avoid teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards. Use Cyan (#00E5FF).
Forbidden color: #7351B7.
Hover state color must be a lighter hue of the active state.

surfaces: Glassmorphism (Crystal Variant): Used for sticky headers, modal overlays, floating spatial UI cards. Requires backdrop-blur-xl or 2xl, bg-black/60, and a delicate 1px inner stroke (border-white/10).
Tracing Beam: Animated glowing border for active missions and live call UI cards. Use a framer-motion div tracing the border with blur-md.
Grid Borders: Visible skeleton for data-heavy sections (vendor comparisons). Use border-r border-b border-white/10.
shadows: Ambient Shadow: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] for glass cards.
Neon Glow: drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,229,255,0.5)] for primary active 3D UI elements.
rules: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface with content underneath.
Never apply one surface style globally. Mix glass for floating UI with solid flat cards for heavy data.
Images/3D backgrounds must have appropriate overlays to maintain text contrast (APCA compliant).

grids_layouts.marketing_page: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A). Asymmetry, gap-8 to gap-12. Span logic mixing Hero, Square, Tall, Filler.
grids_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.
grids_layouts.spatial_ui: UI elements float over a fixed 3D canvas (z-index: 10). Use generous padding (p-8, p-12) for layout breathing room.
rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Mobile-first responsive grids.
Direct Children Only for Grid items.

animations: Hover states: translate-y-[-2px] with glow effect.
Entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items (Framer Motion).
Waveform: Dynamic height scaling for live AI voice calls.
Transitions: Use specific properties, never 'all' (e.g. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Ensure meaning isn't conveyed only through motion.

usage: Central AI Buyer orchestration network visualization.
Animate transitions between states (e.g. 50 candidate nodes -> 20 shortlisted -> 10 verified).
Must have adequate lighting (<Environment>, ambientLight, pointLight).
Render as a fixed full-screen canvas underneath the UI HUD layer.

shadcn_customization: Use pure HTML+Tailwind for spatial layout structure.
Use Shadcn for Interactive logic (Forms, Modals, Select). Strip 'Vercel-look'.
Use @phosphor-icons/react (duotone weight) or lucide-react for icons.
custom_elements: Live Voice Call UI: Vendor avatar, call status, elapsed time, waveform visualizer, live transcript, AI listening state.
Vendor Comparison UI: Tables, charts, cost breakdown, risk indicators.
Pipeline Timeline: Real-time activity feed with glowing nodes.

images.category: Hero Section Background / Fallback for 3D network

rules: No placeholder images. Use curated URLs.
Mobile images max height 80vh.
Normal text: Min 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
Large text: Min 3:1 contrast ratio.
Always explicitly set text color on hover.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and spatial UI.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) and 1px borders.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp with interaction animations).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🔮, 🎯) for icons. Use proper icon libraries.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Add subtle grain textures and noise overlays for premium feel.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers.
instructions_to_main_agent: This project uses .js/.jsx files (not .tsx). Adjust all implementation commands accordingly.
Install required 3D dependencies: npm install three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei @react-three/postprocessing
Install icon library: npm install @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react
Use framer-motion for UI transitions and spatial pop-ins.
Build a full-screen R3F Canvas as a background provider. Overlay the UI using pointer-events-none on containers and pointer-events-auto on interactive elements.
For the 3D visualization, map application state (vendors discovered, shortlisted) to 3D node counts and colors.
Use Unbounded font for headings, Manrope for body text. Inject via Google Fonts in index.html.
